Model of a Granary with Scribes
Tomb of Meketre, Thebes. c. 1981–1975 BCE
Wood, plaster, paint, linen, grain
6 sack carriers
9 men measuring and accounting
4 scribes: 2 papyrus scrolls, 2 wooden writing boards
- The Metropolitan Museum of Art

Model Bakery and Brewery from the Tomb of Meketre
Thebes. c. 1981–1975 BCE
Wood, gesso, paint, linen
Brewery: grain crushing, milling, dough mixing, mashing, fermentation
Bakery: pestles, millstones, dough tubs, 2 ovens, 2 circular stoves
- The Metropolitan Museum of Art
